verdict.rationale: mParticle's Data Privacy Controls docs say consent state drives both GDPR consent and the CCPA data-sale opt-out, with forwarding rules such as "Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present." Together with the dedicated Consent Filters and GDPR/CCPA compliance guides, this is a first-party mechanism that captures consent and enforces it on downstream destinations. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of per-category consent purpose handling (the Consent Filters doc is cited by title only), and independent or hands-on corroboration that opt-outs are honored automatically across destinations.
